WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID AS patient_id,
        p.SEX AS sex,
        AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc,
        AVG(l.HGB / NULLIF(l.HCT, 0)) AS avg_hgb_hct_ratio
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
with_overall_mean AS (
    SELECT
        patient_id,
        sex,
        avg_wbc,
        avg_hgb_hct_ratio,
        AVG(avg_hgb_hct_ratio) OVER () AS overall_mean_ratio
    FROM patient_averages
)
SELECT
    patient_id,
    sex,
    avg_wbc,
    avg_hgb_hct_ratio,
    avg_hgb_hct_ratio - overall_mean_ratio AS ratio_minus_overall_mean
FROM with_overall_mean
WHERE avg_hgb_hct_ratio > overall_mean_ratio
ORDER BY ratio_minus_overall_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
